title: Eleven Boxes of Tools
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：object　|　正文 383 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 object 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When my grandfather died nobody wanted his tools: eleven boxes of them, chisels with cracked handles, a rusted plane, and three nameless tools. To my mother they were simply ① objects taking up space. Every object in those boxes had a name I did not know. To me they were something else entirely, though I could not have said what.

My uncle offered to sell them, and my grandmother objected to this in the only way she ever did — by saying nothing at all for nine days, which unsettled him far more than any argument could have. The ② object of her silence, I eventually understood, was not the tools themselves but my grandfather's stubborn hope that somebody would use them.

So I spent that summer learning what each one was for. An old carpenter three streets away taught me freely and complained about how I held a file. 'One small chisel,' he said, 'is worth nothing if nobody knows its purpose' — a remark which applies to rather more than tools. No object in that shed was valuable, and none was worthless either.

Slowly the tools came back to life. Blades were freed with patience and vinegar; handles were oiled; two boxes went to the village school. In the grammar of my schooling things had always been ③ objects to be measured, and nothing in eleven years had prepared me for caring about an ④ object because somebody's hands had shaped it.

Money, my uncle said more than once, is no ⑤ object when it saves us the trouble of deciding. The ⑥ object of the exercise, she said once, is not ownership but use: a working tool is a conversation with whoever made it, and that conversation continues while somebody still holds it. I have kept one plain rule from her ever since: never keep anything ⑦ with the object of remembering somebody else's life instead of your own. Everything else — the auctions, the photographs, the ⑧ objects of everybody's admiration in glass cases — is simply a way of not deciding at all. ⑨ Every tool, she said once, objected to being shut in a box, and I have never been able to prove her wrong. ⑩ Every object in that shed was asking exactly the same question, and it took me a whole summer to hear it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 目的；宗旨（the object of ...）
E. v. 反对（object to sth/doing）
F. 固定搭配：money is no object 钱不成问题；不计代价
G. 固定搭配：the object of the exercise 此举的目的所在
H. 固定搭配：with the object of doing 以期；目的是……

items.q: they were simply objects taking up space
things had always been objects to be measured
caring about an object simply because somebody's hands had shaped it
is no object when it saves us the trouble
with the object of remembering somebody else's life
objected to being shut in a box
Every object in that shed was asking the same question

answers.why: 母亲眼里这些工具只是占地方的“物件、实物”，毫无感情色彩。
the object of her silence 意为“她沉默的目的”，不在工具本身而在祖父的心愿。
与 grammar、lessons 同现，things had always been objects 用的是语法术语“宾语”。
因某人的手加工而珍视的“物体”，与第 1 题同为实物的意思。
money is no object 意为“钱不成问题”，叔叔认为只要省得纠结，钱可以不计。
the object of the exercise 意为“此举的目的所在”，祖母点明目的不是占有而是使用。
with the object of doing 意为“目的是……”，作者定下自己的取舍原则。
objects of admiration 意为“被羡慕的对象”，指玻璃柜里那些被供奉起来的东西。
object to doing 是动词“反对”，此处用拟人说法：每件工具都不愿意被关在箱子里。
同样指具体的物件，此处说棚里的每一件物品都在问同一个问题。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 对母亲来说，它们不过是占地方的物件。（object n.）
祖母沉默的目的根本不在那些工具。（the object of）
只要能省得做决定，钱就不成问题。（money is no object）
这件事的目的不是占有，而是使用。（the object of the exercise）
我保留东西从不是为了纪念别人。（with the object of）
玻璃柜里的物件不过是人人羡慕的对象。（objects of admiration）
answers: To my mother they were simply objects taking up space.
The object of her silence was not the tools at all.
Money is no object so long as it saves us having to decide.
The object of the exercise is not ownership but use.
I never keep anything with the object of commemorating somebody else.
The things in glass cases are merely objects of everybody's admiration.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 object 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: To my mother my grandfather's tools were simply objects taking up space in eleven boxes.
I later understood that the object of my grandmother's silence was his hope that somebody would use them.
My uncle said money is no object, but the object of the exercise is not ownership; it is use.
In the grammar of my schooling things had always been objects to be measured, never objects to be cared for.
An old carpenter taught me that no small chisel is worth anything if nobody knows its purpose.
I keep one plain rule: never keep anything with the object of remembering somebody else, and leave the auction pieces to become objects of admiration.
